english.title: Driver / operator / manager fail to display sign in smoke-free vehicle used wholly / mainly for work - Wales
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being

(A)_[the driver]_
(B)_[the operator]_
(C)_[a person concerned in the management]_

of a smoke-free vehicle by virtue of regulation 15(2) of the Smoke-free Premises and Vehicles (Wales) Regulations 2020, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE..), failed to make sure that a sign was displayed in the vehicle containing a legible graphic representation of a burning cigarette enclosed with a circle with a bar across the circle which crosses the cigarette symbol
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 18 of the Smoke-free Premises and Vehicles (Wales) Regulations 202 and section 17(3)(b) and (8) of the Public Health (Wales) Act 2017.

english.notes:
(i) Smoke-free vehicles are defined in regulation 15 of the Smoke-free Premises and Vehicles (Wales) Regulations 2020. Vehicles which are smoke-free because they are used in the course of paid or voluntary work are smoke-free all the time, for details see regulation 15(2) and (4).
(ii) The fixed penalty amount is £200 (regulation 20(a) of the Smoke-free Premises and Vehicles (Wales) Regulations 2020); the discounted amount £150 (regulation 21(a)). For the form of the fixed penalty notice, see regulation 22.
